rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for puritanical attitudes about morality, sex, or social behaviour.

example.english: His views on relationships are too puritanical, and he is always saying couples should not be intimate.
example.traditional: 佢對男女關係嘅睇法太保守，成日話拍拖唔應該有親密行為。

rows.note: Use this when the puritanical person or attitude seems rigidly old-fashioned and inflexible.

example.english: Uncle is so old-fashioned and puritanical that he thinks girls who wear short skirts are improper.
example.traditional: 阿叔仲係咁古板，覺得女仔著短裙就係唔正經。

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on harshly strict observance of rules or religious requirements.

example.english: That church has puritanical rules for its members and does not even allow them to watch films on Sundays.
example.traditional: 嗰間教會對教徒嘅規矩非常嚴苛，連星期日睇戲都唔准。
